title: "Install Google ADK"
---

::: {.callout-note}
**Goal:** Install the ADK package inside your virtual environment and confirm the command-line interface is ready.
:::

## Step 1. Confirm the Environment Is Active

Before installing, make sure you see `(.venv)` in your terminal prompt. If not, reactivate it:

<div class="cmd-explain">Reactivate on macOS (zsh):</div>
```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
```

<div class="cmd-explain">Reactivate on Windows (PowerShell):</div>
```powershell
.\\.venv\\Scripts\\Activate.ps1
```

## Step 2. Install the ADK Package

<div class="cmd-explain">Install the Google Agent Development Kit with `pip`:</div>
```bash
pip install google-adk
```

::: {.callout-note}
The command above works on both macOS and Windows while the environment is active. `pip` automatically resolves compatible dependencies for Python 3.11.
:::

## Step 3. Verify the CLI

<div class="cmd-explain">Confirm that the `adk` command is available:</div>
```bash
adk --version
```

::: {.callout-check}
Expect a version string such as `google-adk, version 0.x`. If you see “command not found”, revisit the activation step—the CLI is installed inside `.venv`.
:::

## Step 4. Set the Gemini API Key

You will need an API key from [https://ai.google.dev](https://ai.google.dev). Once you have it, store it as an environment variable before creating projects.

### macOS (zsh)

<div class="cmd-explain">Add the key to your shell profile so it loads automatically:</div>
```bash
echo 'export GEMINI_API_KEY="paste-your-key-here"' >> ~/.zprofile
```

<div class="cmd-explain">Reload the profile to use the key immediately:</div>
```bash
source ~/.zprofile
```

### Windows (PowerShell)

<div class="cmd-explain">Store the key for your user account:</div>
```powershell
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("GEMINI_API_KEY","paste-your-key-here","User")
```

<div class="cmd-explain">Load the new value into the current session:</div>
```powershell
$Env:GEMINI_API_KEY = "paste-your-key-here"
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Treat the API key like a password. Never commit it to version control or share screenshots that display it.
:::

Proceed to **First Agent** to scaffold your project.
